question: Should Control UI assistant messages gain a per-click Markdown/plain-text copy menu, and what exact plain-text conversion semantics should it guarantee?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but code inspection cannot decide whether the extra interaction is desirable or how code blocks, tables, links, and lists should be represented.

options.title: Add per-click format menu
options.body: Keep Markdown as the default action and expose plain text through a small accessible menu with documented conversion semantics.

options.title: Add persisted preference
options.body: Let users choose a default clipboard format, accepting the additional settings and persistence surface.

options.title: Keep Markdown-only copy
options.body: Decline the additional UI and leave users to remove formatting after copying.

recommendation.title: Add per-click format menu
recommendation.body: Keep Markdown as the default action and expose plain text through a small accessible menu with documented conversion semantics.
